title: tasks: act on pending upstream tasks-06 findings
description: Tracking bead from audit JMAP-t8ej.5. Mark's jmapio/jmap issues, all OPEN; act once upstream decides. #456 Task FilterCondition: crate uses single taskListId (tasks-types/src/task.rs:567-630), no Task/get timeZone (tasks-server/src/task.rs:140), no expandRecurrences. #461 owner definition (PR #462): add is_task_owner helper, require in mayWriteOwn contract (tasks-server/src/backend.rs:148,211). #463 utcDue nullability (PR #464): crate omits the key instead of sending null (tasks-server/src/task.rs:142-147). #465 workflowStatus vs progress overlap: no check in handle_task_set. #470 participant matching via calendarAddress not sendTo/scheduleId (tasks-types/src/capability.rs:165-169, task.rs:89 doc). NOTE: issue #463 says the crate returns null (it omits the key) and #456 says the crate uses inTaskLists (it uses taskListId); those issue texts misdescribe the crate.
close_reason: Out of scope (Mark 2026-11-01): tracks Mark's own open upstream IETF proposals; WG decisions will arrive as new draft versions
